Run away
Jun 2025 • Couples
Want a good pepper steak? Run away.
The Cumin’d thinks it’s a steakhouse... but on the plate, it’s a different story: two pieces of meat worthy of butcher’s scrap, so fat that we still look for meat, served with four fries who fought in a duel on a golden plate — all to be cut with butter knives.
It took more energy to slice the meat than to eat it. As a result, we swallowed the four fries (they were at least not greasy), and two or three vaguely edible bits.
Anyway, a nice scam coated in gilding. For fans of eye-catching scenery and ghost cooking.
I put 1 because we can’t put zero.

Real Italian Pizza in Nha Trang Vietnam
Oct 2024 • Solo
I've been here in Vietnam 5 months, Beautiful country, gorgeous beach and delicious Vietnamese foods but after 5 months I was tired and missing my Italian food until I found this tiny place Cumin' D Pizza & Bistro in Loc Tho Nha Trang City, I ordered a Margarita Pizza, oh my God let me tell you, so so good, taste good, smell that fresh basil on the pizza it's reminded me Johny Pizza in New York City and Vincent Pizza in New Jersey. Bolognese spaghetti is delicious. I ended up ate the entire pizza pie and spaghetti all by myself. I Recommend this place so highly and meet the cute Vietnamese owner couple Tam and Mai. I'm going to post a picture of the Pizza for you to see.
